run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 (Commonwealth AusTender) covered well via web-search of indexed ATM detail pages, yielding several buyer-originated open opportunities with real closing dates and scope (Dept of Parliamentary Services lift maintenance, ANSTO pulsed-power-supply EOI, DFAT Australia-Indonesia Leadership Dialogue). Tier 2 (universities via their TenderLink portals, water corporations, local councils via VendorPanel, energy networks) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio/Woolworths/Coles/major corporates) were queried at the search level. As with prior runs, ALL direct page fetches were blocked: both the WebFetch egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) and Bash curl through the agent proxy (403 connect_rejected by organisation egress policy) refused every destination (www.tenders.gov.au and all other portals). No tender detail page or specification document could be opened, so every field is corroborated from search-result snippets of the buyer's own AusTender/portal listing, not from a live fetch. New-source discovery surfaced the University of Technology Sydney TenderLink e-tender portal.
gaps: Direct fetch fully blocked this run: WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED and Bash curl returns 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403 / connect_rejected (organisation egress policy)' for www.tenders.gov.au and every other portal tried. No tender detail page or attachment could be read; all detail is from search snippets, so documents/evaluation-criteria/contact fields are largely null. Per proxy guidance, 403 policy denials were not retried.

Tier 1 state portals (NSW buy.nsw/eTendering, VIC Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tas, NT QTOL, ACT) expose only search-form landing pages to the search index (no per-tender snippets), so they could not be swept tender-by-tender without portal access; deferred to a run with fetch access.

SAP Ariba Discovery and the major corporate buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths Partner Hub, Coles, NAB Ariba, Qantas Coupa) expose no publicly-visible open RFx without a supplier login; all remain registration-gated and are recorded as portals only, no tenders invented. No publicly-advertised corporate RFx was found this run.

Cootamundra-Gundagai Regional Council has an open tender via VendorPanel closing 16 September 2026 2:00pm (confirmed from the council's own current-tenders page), but its title and scope could not be resolved from search snippets without opening the VendorPanel listing, so it is recorded as a source, not as a fabricated tender.

EFA2026002 (Export Finance Australia, Reinsurance Brokerage Services) was seen on AusTender's current ATM list but the search snippet returned a contradictory/likely-past closing date (5 July 2026); excluded to avoid recording an unverifiable date. AusTender 10033173 (Wheelchair Accessible Vehicle, Christmas Island) was excluded because it closed 24 August 2026.
'Tenders SA' searches remain polluted by South-African results; South Australian coverage this run is weak and deferred.
recommended_seed_additions: University of Technology Sydney E-Tendering (TenderLink) - https://www.tenderlink.com/uts and https://portal.tenderlink.com/uts/alltenders/ - buyer-originated university procurement portal (register a free supplier account for full opportunity detail).
Export Finance Australia - Annual Procurement Plan / AusTender ATMs (buyer-originated Commonwealth statutory body; publishes RFTs such as EFA2026002 Reinsurance Brokerage Services via AusTender).

tenders.title: Lift System Maintenance at Australian Parliament House - Request for Tender
tenders.category: Building construction and support and maintenance and repair services
tenders.description: The Department of Parliamentary Services (DPS) invites tenders for the provision of lift system maintenance services at Australian Parliament House (APH) in Canberra.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of ongoing maintenance of the lift systems at Australian Parliament House - keeping the building's lifts safe, compliant and operational. A mandatory industry briefing forms part of the process; the specific maintenance regime, standards and performance requirements are set out in the RFT documents (not accessible this run).
key_deliverables: Scheduled and reactive maintenance of the APH lift systems
Compliance and safety servicing of lift equipment at Australian Parliament House
tenders.eligibility: Open (public approach to market via AusTender); attendance at the mandatory industry briefing is required to tender.
tenders.briefing: Mandatory industry briefing 10:00 AM (ACT) 11 September 2026; registration for the briefing closes 2:00 PM (ACT) 9 September 2026.
mandatory_conditions: Attendance at the mandatory industry briefing (11 September 2026) is required to submit a tender
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM listing DPS26000961 read from web-search snippet of the AusTender detail page (detail page itself egress-blocked); closing date/time, mandatory briefing dates and questions-due date taken from the snippet.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via web search of AusTender current ATMs; buyer-originated Commonwealth RFT published by the Department of Parliamentary Services.
tenders.notes: Publish date, contract value, evaluation criteria, contact and RFT documents were not captured because the AusTender detail page and attachments could not be fetched (egress-blocked). Briefing registration (9 Sep) and briefing (11 Sep) are imminent/passing relative to run date.

tenders.title: Expression of Interest - Pulsed Power Supply for Non-Linear Injection Kicker Magnet, Australian Synchrotron Storage Ring
tenders.buyer: Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation (ANSTO) - Australian Synchrotron
tenders.category: Scientific / specialised electrical power supply equipment
tenders.description: ANSTO (via the Australian Synchrotron in Clayton, Victoria) is running an Expression of Interest to understand market capability for the supply of a high-current, high-voltage pulsed power supply (PPS) for a non-linear injection kicker magnet (NLK) in the synchrotron storage ring (SR). Shortlisted suppliers will be invited to a Request for Tender phase.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Design and supply of a high-current, high-voltage pulsed power supply (PPS) to drive a non-linear injection kicker (NLK) magnet in the Australian Synchrotron storage ring. This EOI seeks to understand current market capability, experience, delivery method and compliance; a Request for Tender to shortlisted respondents is planned for October 2026.
key_deliverables: High-current, high-voltage pulsed power supply for the non-linear injection kicker magnet
Evidence of capability, experience, delivery method and compliance (EOI stage)
tenders.scope_of_work: The purpose of the EOI is for ANSTO to understand the current market capabilities, experience, delivery method and compliance for the supply of a high current and high voltage pulsed power supply (PPS) for a non-linear injection kicker magnet (NLK) in the storage ring (SR) of the Australian Synchrotron, a world-class research facility in Clayton, Victoria.
tenders.eligibility: Open EOI; qualified vendors of specialised pulsed-power-supply equipment. Preferred suppliers will be shortlisted for the Request for Tender phase.
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM listing PSC002916-01 read from web-search snippet; EOI purpose/scope and the two-stage EOI-then-RFT timing from the snippet. Contact email/phone are ANSTO's published procurement contact (ansto.gov.au), not confirmed as the tender contact officer.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via web search of AusTender current ATMs; buyer-originated Commonwealth EOI published by ANSTO for the Australian Synchrotron.
tenders.notes: EOI closes 09/09/2026 (noon per snippet) - imminent. Preferred suppliers to be selected for an RFT phase with tender to market ~05/10/2026. Full EOI documents, value and formal contact officer not captured (detail page egress-blocked); contact fields are ANSTO's general procurement line and need verification against the notice.
